profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Vanguard | Node.js, TypeScript, Angular | APIs, SRE, Observability
profile.summary:
Software Engineer II with 3+ years of experience building and supporting scalable applications in a FinTech environment at Vanguard.

I specialize in developing and integrating RESTful APIs using TypeScript, Node.js, and Angular, with a strong focus on performance, reliability, and clean architecture. My work spans both frontend and backend systems, enabling seamless user experiences across web and mobile platforms.

In my current role, I serve as the Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) for my team, leading efforts in monitoring, alerting, and incident response. I have implemented observability solutions using OpenTelemetry, Honeycomb, and Splunk, and defined SLIs/SLOs to improve system visibility and reliability.

I enjoy working in collaborative environments, learning new technologies quickly, and building systems that are both scalable and resilient.

positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain micro frontends (MFEs) and frontend applications using Angular, TypeScript, and modern web architecture patterns
- Build and optimize RESTful APIs for scalable, high-performance applications
- Contribute to development of a new application (TXV) supporting Tax-Loss Harvesting and Municipal investment workflows
- Serve as team SRE, leading monitoring, alerting, and incident response
- Implement observability using OpenTelemetry; analyze systems with Honeycomb and Splunk
- Define and maintain SLIs/SLOs to improve system reliability and performance
- Integrate workflows across partner teams (PTJ, PBJ) to support cross-team delivery
- Deploy applications using GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description:
- Developed and enhanced applications using Angular and Node.js in an enterprise environment
- Built and integrated APIs supporting internal and client-facing systems
- Contributed to migration of applications to Constellation, improving performance and maintainability
- Participated in code reviews and adopted Angular best practices for clean, scalable code
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to deliver features in an Agile environment
positions.insights: Agile Web Development, API Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Copywriter
positions.description:
- Enhanced outdated articles for the Charlotte Regional Visitors Authority by updating information and restructuring content to align with current public interests and political climate.
- Demonstrated strong research skills to gather accurate and relevant information, ensuring all articles were well-informed and credible.
- Adapted writing style to suit diverse topics, showcasing versatility and the ability to engage a wide range of audiences.

positions.title: Retail Associate
positions.description:
- Executed a range of sales duties in a high-traffic department store, including handling point-of-sale transactions, opening and closing procedures, cleaning, stocking, and maintaining product knowledge.
- Achieved a 90% customer satisfaction rating by delivering prompt, high-quality service, which contributed to client retention and adherence to company standards.
- Ensured the store's visual appeal by performing front and back stocking, product facing, and maintaining organized displays to enhance the shopping experience.
